newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia 91-day Bank Negara bills yield 6.632 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia 91-day Bank Negara bills yield 6.632 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's central bank said on Tuesday it accepted bids at an average yield of 6.632 percent at its auction of 91-day Bank Negara bills for one billion ringgit.
At its previous auction on November 19 for 91-day bills worth 500 million ringgit, the central bank accepted bids at an average yield of 6.755 percent.
The bids accepted in the latest auction were in high/low range of 6.683/545 percent, the central bank said.
It also accepted bids at an average yield of 6.625 percent at its auction of 30-day Bank Negara bills for 500 million ringgit.
The bids accepted were in high/low range of 6.690/550 percent.
Bank Negara bills are issued by the central bank usually to keep a check on liquidity. It also issues treasury bills on behalf of the federal government.
